01_Assessor_-_Parcel_Sales_2023_2025.csv.neighborhood_code: Assessor neighborhood code, first two digits are township, last three are neighborhood
01_Assessor_-_Parcel_Sales_2023_2025.csv.is_mydec_date: Indicates whether the sale date has been overwritten with a more precise value from IDOR (Illinois Department of Revenue). In the past the Assessor's ingest process truncated sale dates to the first of the month. Not all sales can be updated with dates from IDOR.
01_Assessor_-_Parcel_Sales_2023_2025.csv.sale_document_num: Sale document number. Corresponds to Clerk's document number
01_Assessor_-_Parcel_Sales_2023_2025.csv.mydec_deed_type: Deed type from MyDec, more granular than CCAO deed type
01_Assessor_-_Parcel_Sales_2023_2025.csv.is_multisale: Indicates whether a parcel was sold individually or as part of a larger group of PINs (1=False, 0=True)
01_Assessor_-_Parcel_Sales_2023_2025.csv.num_parcels_sale: The number of parcels that were part of the sale
01_Assessor_-_Parcel_Sales_2023_2025.csv.sale_filter_same_sale_within_365: Remove sale with the same value (for the same PIN) within 365 days (1=False, 0=True)
01_Assessor_-_Parcel_Sales_2023_2025.csv.sale_filter_less_than_10k: Indicator for whether sale is less than $10K FMV (1=False, 0=True)
01_Assessor_-_Parcel_Sales_2023_2025.csv.sale_filter_deed_type: Indicator for quit claim, executor, beneficiary and missing deed types (1=False, 0=True)

03_Assessor_-_Assessed_Values_2023_2025..neighborhood_code: Assessor neighborhood code, first two digits are township, last three are neighborhood
03_Assessor_-_Assessed_Values_2023_2025..mailed_bldg: Mailed assessed value of the building (before any appeals)
03_Assessor_-_Assessed_Values_2023_2025..mailed_land: Mailed assessed value of the land (before any appeals)
03_Assessor_-_Assessed_Values_2023_2025..mailed_tot: Mailed total assessed value, building plus land (before any appeals)
03_Assessor_-_Assessed_Values_2023_2025..certified_bldg: Certified assessed value of the building (after township assessor review)
03_Assessor_-_Assessed_Values_2023_2025..certified_land: Certified assessed value of the land (after township assessor review)
03_Assessor_-_Assessed_Values_2023_2025..certified_tot: Certified total assessed value, building plus land (after township assessor review)
03_Assessor_-_Assessed_Values_2023_2025..board_bldg: Board of Review assessed value of the building (after appeals)
03_Assessor_-_Assessed_Values_2023_2025..board_land: Board of Review assessed value of the land (after appeals)
03_Assessor_-_Assessed_Values_2023_2025..board_tot: Board of Review total assessed value, building plus land (after appeals)
03_Assessor_-_Assessed_Values_2023_2025..board_hie: Board of Review homeowner improvement exemption value

04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.tax_year: Tax year of the characteristics record
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.card_num: Card number, used when a PIN has multiple improvement cards (e.g. multi-building parcels)
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.proration_key_pin: Key PIN used for proration when a parcel is split across multiple cards
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.pin_proration_rate: Proration rate for the PIN, used to allocate value across multiple cards
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.card_proration_rate: Proration rate for the individual card
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.cdu: Condition, desirability, and utility rating assigned by the assessor
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.pin_is_multicard: Indicates whether the PIN has more than one improvement card
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.pin_num_cards: Number of improvement cards associated with the PIN
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.pin_is_multiland: Indicates whether the PIN has more than one land line
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.pin_num_landlines: Number of land lines associated with the PIN
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.year_built: Year the primary structure was built
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.building_sqft: Above-grade finished square footage of the building
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.land_sqft: Square footage of the land parcel
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.type_of_residence: Type of residential structure (e.g. single family, two-flat, etc.)
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.construction_quality: Construction quality grade assigned by the assessor
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.num_apartments: Number of apartment units (for multi-family properties)
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.attic_finish: Type of attic finish (e.g. living area, unfinished, none)
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.garage_attached: Indicates whether the property has an attached garage
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.garage_area_included: Indicates whether the garage area is included in the building square footage
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.garage_size: Size of the garage (number of cars or square footage depending on record)
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.garage_ext_wall_material: Exterior wall material of the garage
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.attic_type: Indicates whether the property has a usable attic
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.basement_type: Type of basement (e.g. full, partial, crawl space, none)
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.ext_wall_material: Exterior wall material of the main structure
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.repair_condition: Overall repair condition of the structure as assessed
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.basement_finish: Type of basement finish (e.g. improved, unimproved, none)
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.single_v_multi_family: Indicates whether the property is single-family or multi-family
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.site_desirability: Site desirability rating assigned by the assessor
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.num_commercial_units: Number of commercial units on the parcel
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.renovation: Indicates whether the property has been renovated
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.porch: Type of porch or deck present on the property
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.central_air: Indicates whether the property has central air conditioning
04_Assessor_-_Single_and_Multi-Family_Im.design_plan: Design plan or architectural style code assigned by the assessor
